evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: A natural approach is to train a shared policy through multiple harnesses, but doing so introduces a scheduling problem: each training step should favor a harness that currently provides a useful learning signal while also producing an update that benefits the other harnesses.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We train Qwen3.5-2B across six harnesses on ClawGym and evaluate on PinchBench (held-out tasks, in-distribution OpenClaw) and ClawEval (held-out tasks and harness).

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: The same model can perform unevenly across these interfaces, making robustness to harness variation an important objective.
